label: Wärmepumpe / Wärmespeicher (Stub)
description: Not in M1 EHAL plant wire; live as thermal_annual flex + heat-store signals, exchanged as heatpump.{hk_id}.<field>. Level 0: enable, optional power, T_eq / T_low. Level 1 (HeatControl P2): optional SG-Ready state next to the enable. Level 2 (P3): optional store charge target. Level 3 (HeatControl P1): read-only feedback of the controller; all optional. Design: docs/dev/heat-control-sg-ready.md § 6.

ehal_fields.notes: Level 1 (HeatControl P2). SG-Ready operating state: 3 where the plan runs the generator (charge up to setpoint + boost), otherwise 2. 4 (HeatControl P5, only with COP points in the heating system): a planned run on a negative buy price or on curtailed surplus. State 1 is not sent yet. Fail-safe: the backend falls back to 2 when status.json is stale.

Level 2 (HeatControl P3). Store charge target in °C where the plan runs the generator: the planned end temperature of the run, between the setpoint and setpoint + boost (capped by get_temperature_heat_storage_max). 0 = no target (normal operation). Fail-safe: 0 when status.json is stale.
Heat storage T_eq (°C) on thermal_annual ehal_bindings. HA: map a °C sensor entity.
Heat storage bottom sensor T_low (°C). HA: map lowest immersion sensor entity.
Level 3. Top store sensor (°C): hot-water comfort and upper charge limit.
Level 3. Controller's present store setpoint (°C). With the tolerance mapped too, Live plans with this band instead of heat_storage.setpoint_c / tolerance_c.
Level 3. Band below the setpoint in which the controller does not yet request heat (K, >= 0).
Level 3. Highest store temperature the controller allows (°C). Recorded only until HeatControl P3/P5.
Level 3. Enum 0 off, 1 space heating, 2 hot water, 3 defrost, 4 locked, 5 cooling, 6 fault: what the controller requests; whether the compressor runs comes from the electric power.
Level 3. SG-Ready state 1-4 the controller applies (differs from the request while it overrides).
Level 3. Thermal power of the generator (heat meter), W on the EHAL wire.
Level 3. Source temperature (brine, ground water) in °C during operation; the backend holds the last valid value at standstill.
Level 3. Separate hot-water tank (°C), if present.
Level 3. Reference room or mean of the participating rooms (°C).

unit_sign_notes: Stub only — not part of M1 plant wire. Temperatures °C, tolerance K, sens_heat_power W (Loxone kW). See docs/referenz/ehal.md and docs/referenz/loxone-signals.md.
